_comment: Curated MCP servers. `default: true` are installed by ./install at user scope. Others: ./install --mcp <name>. Entries with `env` prompt for the variable if unset.

sequential-thinking.why: Structured step-by-step reasoning for audits and spec decomposition.

memory.why: Knowledge-graph memory across sessions: mentee growth notes, audit findings.

context7.why: Up-to-date library docs when picking up a new language or framework.

mcp-compass.why: From the source list: discover and evaluate other MCP servers by natural-language query.

github.why: PR review, issues and CI status for the mentoring-code-review and orchestration flows. Uses your gh token.

playwright.why: Browser automation for front-end acceptance tests and onboarding-funnel verification.

postgres.why: Read-only DB inspection for the redundant-query and slow-query audits.

mcp-installer.why: From the source list: lets Claude install further MCP servers by name. Convenience only; review what it installs.
